name: World Bible Builder
description: Assemble a versionable world bible from concept through conflict sources, then human canon review. Field names are stable for future Canon mapping. This pack does not write canon, characters, locations, or factions. Workflow execution is not implemented.

stages.title: Concept
stages.intent: State the world's core distinction and the stories it can support.

stages.title: Rules
stages.intent: Record hard limits of physics, magic, or law.

stages.title: Geography
stages.intent: Name regions, routes, climates, and chokepoints.

stages.title: History
stages.intent: List the few past events that still pressure the present.

stages.title: Society
stages.intent: Describe class, kinship, labor, and everyday constraint.

stages.title: Technology / Magic
stages.intent: Define tools of power and their costs.

stages.title: Conflict Sources
stages.intent: Name structural conflicts the plot can occupy.

stages.title: Canon Review
stages.intent: Human review before any future canon write.
